IS 1254 : 2025 Corrugated Aluminium Sheet
ICS 77.150.10
ICS 77.150.10
MTD 07
MTD 07
1 SCOPE
This standard specifies the material, profile dimensions and finish for the corrugated aluminium sheets meant for following uses:
a) General purpose;
b) Industrial;
c) Building; and
d) High stiffness industrial sheet.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicted were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards:
